entries.reason: THE platform-key resolver and the LOB_LIVE_SEND_ENABLED arm switch. The single sanctioned home for Lob credential env reads; mailLanes.ts calls it and nothing else does.
Lob us_verifications lookups only (raw fetch, no client, no letters/postcards endpoint). A lookup on AcreOS's own account prints no paper and reaches no counterparty.
Reports whether a platform Lob key exists for the vendor health panel. Presence read; constructs nothing.
Launch-readiness prose telling the founder to set LOB_LIVE_SEND_ENABLED=true in production. A string in guidance copy.
Credential-liveness audit detector; reads key presence to report staleness across all vendors uniformly.
Config-key registry: names LOB_API_KEY / LOB_WEBHOOK_SECRET as metadata rows (label, hint, docUrl) for the setup surface.
Platform-connection descriptor: names the env vars a founder fills in, plus the note that the live-send interlock is deliberately separate.
PLATFORM_ENV_MAP — the channel→platform-env-var table, uniform across all fourteen BYOK channels.
Setup wizard key validation: pings Lob with the configured key and records ok/error. Validation only — outside this lane's file set by explicit scope fence.
Founder integrations catalogue: envVars/flySecretName metadata for the Lob row.
Founder intelligence readout — a boolean 'is direct mail configured' presence read.
LOB_WEBHOOK_SECRET — inbound signature verification. Not a credential for sending.
Support agent answering 'does this org have direct-mail credentials' — presence read, constructs no client.
Founder setup wizard copy: names LOB_API_KEY as the secret to paste, with its dashboard URL. Client-side; no server credential access.
Vendor health probe: reports which vendor keys are set. Ops script, no send.
Pins the interlock's armed/disarmed key-selection behaviour — it must set the env vars to test them.
Pins the credential-liveness detector, which reads Lob key presence.
The R-2 exit test: it must set and unset platform Lob keys to prove the refusal and wedge paths.
